cc:Work.dc:description: Conditional G12 versus G9 rest-to-60-mph time reduction at fixed 2000 kg, 1200 Nm, 0.34 m wheel radius and efficiencies. Both gears satisfy the rpm cutoff. Exactly zero benefit for mu at or below 1.570426; above that coefficient the gain is positive but depends on DC power. No real tyre capability is asserted.
